$comment: Neutral MCP server list, generated into each tool's config. stdio: {command, args, env}; remote: {url}. Values use ${VAR} for secrets, never literals. Roles reference a server as the capability mcp:<name>. Servers run from the repository root.

playwright.description: Browser automation for ux-designer (capture current UI) and frontend-engineer / ui-reviewer (check rendered states). Local only; no credentials.

tracker.description: The team's ticket tracker (Jira behind a neutral tool surface) for product-manager and tech-lead: search, read, create, update, move, comment and link a pull request. Reads its own credentials from .env.local; no secrets pass through this file or any agent's environment.
